mainStyle.name: Main Style
mainStyle.summary: Shared visual style and raster presentation for every DepthPlan UI icon, ready for later SVG conversion.
mainStyle.prompt:
Create one original monochrome interface icon for DepthPlan, a desktop diagram and architecture editor. Follow the selected asset prompt for its meaning and exact geometry. Produce a single raster master that will later be traced into SVG; do not output code, an SVG source listing, an application screenshot, or a UI mockup. Design original artwork from the described action rather than tracing or reproducing an existing icon library.

Use precise geometric line art with rounded stroke ends and joins, clear negative space, and the optical weight of a 2-unit stroke on a 24-by-24 design grid. Keep line weight, corner treatment, scale, and padding consistent across the whole icon family. Prefer open outlines for shapes and containers. Simple arrowheads, lettering and small marks may use solid black where their meaning calls for it. The symbol must remain immediately recognizable when reduced to 16, 20 and 24 pixels. Distinguish object-alignment icons, which use rectangles and a guide, from text-alignment icons, which use short text-like strokes.

Render the icon straight on as flat, two-dimensional artwork, using opaque black on a transparent background. Use a square 1024-by-1024 canvas. Center the complete symbol optically, keep it fully visible, and leave approximately 12.5 percent clear padding on each side. If transparency is unavailable, use a uniform pure-white background. Do not draw a checkerboard. There is no light source, material, environment or perspective. Do not add a button container, tile, badge or surrounding border unless that outline is part of the specified symbol.

Keep contours crisp and simple for raster-to-vector conversion. Separate strokes or small disconnected elements are allowed when needed to express the icon, but avoid stray marks and tiny details. Preserve intentional holes and gaps. Generate only the requested asset, never a contact sheet or alternate versions. The target SVG filename in the asset summary is a naming reference, not text to draw. Create only the neutral icon; the application supplies hover, active and disabled colors. If an accepted icon from this set is supplied as a style reference, match its visual weight and corner treatment while preserving the new asset's own geometry.

mainNegatives.name: Main Negatives
mainNegatives.summary: Shared exclusions that keep the icon family monochrome, readable at small sizes, and easy to vectorize.
mainNegatives.prompt:
No photographs, realistic objects, three-dimensional forms, isometric or perspective views, scenery, people, creatures, material textures, gradients, shadows, lighting effects, glow, bevels, embossing or decorative color. No gray fills, soft blur, sketch marks, rough edges, halftone, distressed surfaces, thin hairlines or excessive tracing detail. Normal edge antialiasing is acceptable; keep the interior artwork opaque black.

No labels, captions, filenames, numbers, signatures, logos, watermarks, explanatory text, UI screenshots, multi-icon grids, contact sheets, variant sheets or multiple independent assets. Letters A, B, I, S and U, paired quotation marks, angle brackets, and an exclamation mark are allowed only when explicitly requested as the icon itself. The Numbered List icon alone may use the digits 1, 2 and 3 as its ordered-list markers; no other numbers are allowed. A selected hand or document icon is a simple graphic symbol, not a realistic hand or photographed page.

No background objects, fake transparency checkerboards, cropped arrowheads, cut-off outlines, unbalanced padding or accidental extra marks. Do not add enclosing circles, squares or rounded button tiles unless the selected asset requires them. Do not reverse arrow directions, confuse horizontal with vertical, or swap a text-alignment symbol for an object-alignment symbol. Do not introduce dark-fantasy, game-terrain, medieval, magical or ornamental styling.

assets.name: Text Align Center
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: align-center.svg | Center text.
assets.prompt:
Create the Text Align Center icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Center text.

Three horizontal text strokes of unequal lengths, centered.

Center each stroke on the same vertical axis; leave both outer edges ragged.

assets.name: Text Align Left
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: align-left.svg | Align text left.
assets.prompt:
Create the Text Align Left icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Align text left.

Three horizontal text strokes, flush to the left.

Align the left endpoints precisely; the right endpoints have different lengths.

assets.name: Text Align Right
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: align-right.svg | Align text right.
assets.prompt:
Create the Text Align Right icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Align text right.

Three horizontal text strokes, flush to the right.

Align the right endpoints precisely; the left endpoints have different lengths.

assets.name: Send Backward
assets.summary: Category: LayerOrder | Target SVG: arrow-down.svg | Send backward one layer.
assets.prompt:
Create the Send Backward icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Send backward one layer.

Single downward arrow; no end bar.

This means one step backward in the layer stack. Do not add a stop bar or download tray.

assets.name: Send to Back
assets.summary: Category: LayerOrder | Target SVG: arrow-down-to-line.svg | Send to back.
assets.prompt:
Create the Send to Back icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Send to back.

Downward arrow ending at a horizontal stop bar.

The stop bar means the backmost layer. Keep it separate from the arrow tip by a small clear gap; do not turn it into a download tray.

assets.name: Select Pointer
assets.summary: Category: DrawingTools | Target SVG: arrow-pointer.svg | Select or edit objects.
assets.prompt:
Create the Select Pointer icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Select or edit objects.

Simple mouse-pointer arrow pointing toward the upper left.

assets.name: Arrow Connector
assets.summary: Category: DrawingTools | Target SVG: arrow-right.svg | Draw an arrow connector.
assets.prompt:
Create the Arrow Connector icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Draw an arrow connector.

Thin horizontal line with one arrowhead on the right.

assets.name: Reset Canvas View
assets.summary: Category: CanvasNavigation | Target SVG: arrow-rotate-left.svg | Reset canvas navigation.
assets.prompt:
Create the Reset Canvas View icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Reset canvas navigation.

Counterclockwise circular arrow around a small center point.

Keep the small center point to distinguish navigation reset from the Undo icon. The arrowhead must indicate counterclockwise motion.

assets.name: Bring Forward
assets.summary: Category: LayerOrder | Target SVG: arrow-up.svg | Bring forward one layer.
assets.prompt:
Create the Bring Forward icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Bring forward one layer.

Single upward arrow; no end bar.

This means one step forward in the layer stack. Do not add a stop bar or upload tray.

assets.name: Match Object Size
assets.summary: Category: ObjectArrangement | Target SVG: arrow-up-right-and-arrow-down-left-from-center.svg | Match width / match height.
assets.prompt:
Create the Match Object Size icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Match width / match height.

Double-headed diagonal arrow, running southwest to northeast.

Generate only this southwest-to-northeast master orientation, not three size variants. Both arrowheads point outward. The application rotates the master clockwise 45 degrees for width and counterclockwise 45 degrees for height; provide enough padding for those rotations.

assets.name: Bring to Front
assets.summary: Category: LayerOrder | Target SVG: arrow-up-to-line.svg | Bring to front.
assets.prompt:
Create the Bring to Front icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Bring to front.

Upward arrow ending at a horizontal stop bar.

The stop bar means the frontmost layer. Keep it separate from the arrow tip by a small clear gap; do not turn it into an upload tray.

assets.name: Application Menu
assets.summary: Category: ApplicationControls | Target SVG: bars.svg | Open application menu.
assets.prompt:
Create the Application Menu icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Open application menu.

Three equal horizontal bars.

assets.name: Bold Text
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: bold.svg | Bold text.
assets.prompt:
Create the Bold Text icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Bold text.

Strong, clean capital B, intentionally heavier than the italic I.

Only the single capital B is allowed; do not write the word Bold.

assets.name: Bookmarks
assets.summary: Category: SavedViews | Target SVG: bookmark.svg | Saved views / bookmarks.
assets.prompt:

Vertical ribbon outline with a V-shaped notch at the bottom.

Compact camera outline, one circular lens and a small raised top section.

assets.name: Reveal Children
assets.summary: Category: DepthAndHierarchy | Target SVG: chevron-right.svg | Breadcrumb / reveal children.
assets.prompt:
Create the Reveal Children icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Breadcrumb / reveal children.

Simple right-pointing chevron.

Generate the right-facing master only. The application rotates it clockwise 90 degrees to point down when children are expanded.

Empty diamond outline with equal sides.

assets.summary: Category: ObjectArrangement | Target SVG: distribute-spacing-horizontal.svg | Distribute objects horizontally.
assets.prompt:
Create the Distribute Horizontally icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Distribute objects horizontally.

Three narrow vertical rectangles with visibly equal horizontal gaps.

Show equal left-to-right gaps between three objects. Do not substitute a plain double-headed arrow or a text-alignment symbol.

assets.name: Distribute Vertically
assets.summary: Category: ObjectArrangement | Target SVG: distribute-spacing-vertical.svg | Distribute objects vertically.
assets.prompt:
Create the Distribute Vertically icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Distribute objects vertically.

Three short horizontal rectangles with visibly equal vertical gaps.

Show equal top-to-bottom gaps between three objects. Do not substitute a plain double-headed arrow or a text-alignment symbol.

assets.name: Fit or Expand View

assets.prompt:

Four short corner arrows pointing outward from the center.

Open palm with four fingers and a thumb; simplify details for small sizes.

assets.prompt:

Slanted capital I with short top and bottom strokes.

Three offset stacked planes, with clear separation.

Circular lens with a short diagonal handle.

assets.prompt:
Create the Minimap icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Toggle minimap.

Folded three-panel map outline, no labels or pins.

assets.name: Minus or Line
assets.summary: Category: CanvasNavigation | Target SVG: minus.svg | Zoom out / draw a plain line.
assets.prompt:
Create the Minus or Line icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Zoom out / draw a plain line.

Single horizontal stroke centered vertically.

Keep this one stroke usable both as a minus sign and as a plain line-tool symbol.

assets.name: Align Object Bottoms
assets.summary: Category: ObjectArrangement | Target SVG: objects-align-bottom.svg | Align object bottoms.
assets.prompt:
Create the Align Object Bottoms icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Align object bottoms.

Two rectangles of different heights sitting on a common horizontal bottom guide.

Use two outlined rectangles side by side and one guide below them, not text strokes.

assets.name: Center Objects Horizontally
assets.summary: Category: ObjectArrangement | Target SVG: objects-align-center-horizontal.svg | Center objects on the horizontal axis.
assets.prompt:
Create the Center Objects Horizontally icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Center objects on the horizontal axis.

Two rectangles of different widths, one above the other, centered on a vertical guide.

Horizontal centering means matching the rectangles' left-to-right centers: place them above and below each other, with a vertical guide passing through both centers.

assets.name: Center Objects Vertically
assets.summary: Category: ObjectArrangement | Target SVG: objects-align-center-vertical.svg | Center objects on the vertical axis.
assets.prompt:
Create the Center Objects Vertically icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Center objects on the vertical axis.

Two rectangles of different heights side by side, centered on a horizontal guide.

Vertical centering means matching the rectangles' top-to-bottom centers: place them side by side, with a horizontal guide passing through both centers.

assets.name: Align Object Left Edges
assets.summary: Category: ObjectArrangement | Target SVG: objects-align-left.svg | Align object left edges / arrange selection.
assets.prompt:
Create the Align Object Left Edges icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Align object left edges / arrange selection.

Two rectangles of different widths, one above the other, touching a left vertical guide.

Use two outlined rectangles and one left guide, not paragraph-like text strokes.

assets.name: Align Object Right Edges
assets.summary: Category: ObjectArrangement | Target SVG: objects-align-right.svg | Align object right edges.
assets.prompt:
Create the Align Object Right Edges icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Align object right edges.

Two rectangles of different widths, one above the other, touching a right vertical guide.

Use two outlined rectangles and one right guide, not paragraph-like text strokes.

assets.name: Align Object Tops
assets.summary: Category: ObjectArrangement | Target SVG: objects-align-top.svg | Align object tops.
assets.prompt:
Create the Align Object Tops icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Align object tops.

Two rectangles of different heights hanging from a common horizontal top guide.

Use two outlined rectangles side by side and one guide above them, not text strokes.

assets.name: Add or Zoom In
assets.summary: Category: CanvasNavigation | Target SVG: plus.svg | Zoom in / add bookmark / draw-shape action.
assets.prompt:
Create the Add or Zoom In icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Zoom in / add bookmark / draw-shape action.

Simple plus with equal horizontal and vertical strokes.

Do not surround the plus with a circle or add a separate object; this same master serves several add and zoom actions.

assets.name: Undo
assets.summary: Category: History | Target SVG: rotate-left.svg | Undo.
assets.prompt:
Create the Undo icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Undo.

Curved arrow pointing back toward the left, with no center point.

The arrowhead faces left. This is an undo action, not a circular refresh loop. Do not include the center point used by Reset Canvas View.

assets.name: Redo
assets.summary: Category: History | Target SVG: rotate-right.svg | Redo.
assets.prompt:
Create the Redo icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Redo.

Mirror of Undo, curved arrow pointing toward the right.

The arrowhead faces right. Match Undo in size and curvature as a mirrored partner, not a circular refresh loop.

assets.name: Save
assets.summary: Category: FileOperations | Target SVG: save.svg | Save document or saved view.
assets.prompt:
Create the Save icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Save document or saved view.

Simple diskette silhouette with one top slot and one lower label area.

assets.name: Selection Properties
assets.summary: Category: ApplicationControls | Target SVG: sliders.svg | Selection properties.
assets.prompt:
Create the Selection Properties icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Selection properties.

Three horizontal adjustment tracks with offset rounded slider knobs.

assets.name: Rectangle Tool
assets.summary: Category: DrawingTools | Target SVG: square.svg | Draw a rectangle / empty-canvas hint.
assets.prompt:
Create the Rectangle Tool icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Draw a rectangle / empty-canvas hint.

Empty square outline with subtly rounded corners.

assets.name: Underline Text
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: underline.svg | Underline text.
assets.prompt:
Create the Underline Text icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Underline text.

Capital U with a separate underline beneath it.

Only the single capital U and its underline are allowed; do not write the word Underline.

assets.name: Close
assets.summary: Category: ApplicationControls | Target SVG: xmark.svg | Close panels and dialogs.
assets.prompt:
Create the Close icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Close panels and dialogs.

Two diagonal strokes crossing at their centers.

This master is reused by several dialogs and panels. Do not draw a close-button container.

assets.name: Text Align Justify
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: align-justify.svg | Justify text.
assets.prompt:
Create the Text Align Justify icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Justify text.

Four evenly spaced horizontal text strokes with equal full widths, sharing precise left and right endpoints. Use thin rounded strokes, not solid menu bars. Keep the same footprint and optical weight as Text Align Left, Center and Right; the four flush lines distinguish this from the three-bar Application Menu.

assets.name: Strikethrough Text
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: strikethrough.svg | Toggle strikethrough on selected text.
assets.prompt:
Create the Strikethrough Text icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Toggle strikethrough on selected text.

A single upright capital S crossed through its vertical midpoint by one straight horizontal stroke extending a little beyond both sides. Preserve the curves and open counters so the S remains readable at 16 pixels. Only the S is lettering; do not draw a word, underline or diagonal cancellation slash.

assets.name: Set Text Size
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: text-size.svg | Apply the entered font size to selected text.
assets.prompt:
Create the Set Text Size icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Apply the entered font size to selected text.

Two upright capital A glyphs on a shared baseline: one small A on the left and one taller A on the right. Give both open counters and matching stroke weight, with a clear gap between them. Only these two As are lettering. Do not add a number, arrow, ruler, size label or enclosing button.

assets.name: Set Text Color
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: text-color.svg | Apply the entered text color.
assets.prompt:
Create the Set Text Color icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Apply the entered text color.

One upright capital A with a short thick horizontal swatch directly below it, separated by a clear gap. Keep the A open and legible; the swatch is solid black in this neutral master. Only the A is lettering. Do not draw a colored palette, eyedropper, paint bucket or extra underline through the letter.

assets.name: Bullet List
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: list-bullet.svg | Wrap selected text in an unordered list.
assets.prompt:
Create the Bullet List icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Wrap selected text in an unordered list.

Three small filled circular bullets in a left column, each paired with a horizontal text stroke to its right. Align the three bullets vertically and align all text-stroke starts; vary the stroke lengths slightly. Keep generous bullet-to-text gaps. No digits, checklist boxes, check marks or page outline.

assets.name: Numbered List
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: list-numbered.svg | Wrap selected text in an ordered list.
assets.prompt:
Create the Numbered List icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Wrap selected text in an ordered list.

The small upright digits 1, 2 and 3 in a left column, one per row, each paired with a horizontal text stroke to its right. Align the text-stroke starts and use three evenly spaced rows. Only these three digits are allowed; omit punctuation, words and page outlines. Keep the numerals distinct and readable at 16 pixels.

assets.name: Indent List Item
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: indent.svg | Move the current list item one level deeper.
assets.prompt:
Create the Indent List Item icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Move the current list item one level deeper.

Three horizontal text strokes shifted toward the right, leaving a clear lane on the left. In that lane place one short right-pointing arrow aimed toward the middle text stroke. Keep a gap between the arrowhead and text. The rightward arrow means increase indentation; do not draw object rectangles, a standalone connector or a page border.

assets.name: Outdent List Item
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: outdent.svg | Move the current list item one level outward.
assets.prompt:
Create the Outdent List Item icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Move the current list item one level outward.

Three horizontal text strokes on the right, leaving a clear lane on the left. In that lane place one short left-pointing arrow aimed away from the text strokes. Match the text positions, spacing and optical weight of Indent; reverse only the arrow direction. Do not mirror the entire glyph or draw object rectangles or a page border.

assets.name: Blockquote
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: blockquote.svg | Wrap selected blocks as a quotation.
assets.prompt:
Create the Blockquote icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Wrap selected blocks as a quotation.

A pair of clearly recognizable opening quotation marks above two short horizontal text strokes. Use two compact comma-like quotation forms with simple contours and visible separation. The text strokes sit below the marks with a clear gap. No letters, speech bubble, page outline or decorative container.

assets.name: Unwrap Block
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: unwrap-block.svg | Lift selected content out of its current quote or list wrapper.
assets.prompt:
Create the Unwrap Block icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Lift selected content out of its current quote or list wrapper.

Two short horizontal text strokes between separate left and right bracket-like boundary strokes. Interrupt the right boundary at its midpoint and draw a short right-pointing arrow from beside the text through that opening, ending outside the boundary. Keep the wrapper, text and arrow distinguishable. This removes one structural wrapper while retaining the text: no eraser, trash bin, strikethrough or word-wrap return arrow.

assets.name: Remove Link
assets.summary: Category: TextFormatting | Target SVG: link-remove.svg | Remove a hyperlink while retaining its text.
assets.prompt:
Create the Remove Link icon for DepthPlan. Its interface role is: Remove a hyperlink while retaining its text.

Two diagonal rounded chain-link outlines pulled slightly apart across one clear central break. Place two tiny outward-facing break ticks near the separated ends, with ample negative space. Match the established Link icon in angle, stroke weight and proportions. No arrow, letter, trash bin, enclosing circle or extra chain segment; the break must remain obvious at 16 pixels.
